lines.translation: The sublime essence of the Beloved Naam is utterly sweet.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: naanak kau jug jug har jas deejai har japeeai a(n)t na paaiaa ||5||
lines.translation: O Lord, please bless Nanak with Your Praise in each and every age; meditating on the Lord, I cannot find His limits. ||5||
With the Naam deep within the nucleus of the self, the jewel is obtained.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਪਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਧੀਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: har japate man man te dheeraa ||
lines.translation: Meditating on the Lord, the mind is comforted and consoled by the mind itself.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਘਟ ਘਟ ਭਉ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਜਾਇਆ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: dughat ghat bhau bha(n)jan paaeeai baahuR janam na jaaiaa ||6||
lines.translation: On that most difficult path, the Destroyer of fear is found, and one does not have to enter the womb of reincarnation again. ||6||
Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, inspiration for loving devotional worship wells up.
I beg for the treasure of the Naam, and the Lord's Praise.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਗੁਰ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਤਾਰੇ ਜਗਤੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: har bhaavai gur mel milaae har taare jagat sabaaiaa ||7||
lines.translation: When it pleases the Lord, He unites me in Union with the Guru; the Lord saves the whole world. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਪੁ ਜਪਿਓ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਤਿ ਵਾ ਕੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin jap japio satigur mat vaa ke ||
lines.translation: One who chants the Lord's Chant, attains the Wisdom of the True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਮਕੰਕਰ ਕਾਲੁ ਸੇਵਕ ਪਗ ਤਾ ਕੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jamaka(n)kar kaal sevak pag taa ke ||
lines.translation: The tyrant, the Messenger of Death, becomes a servant at his feet.

lines.gurmukhi: ਊਤਮ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਊਤਮ ਜਗੁ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਤਰਾਇਆ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: ootam sa(n)gat gat mit ootam jag bhaujal paar taraaiaa ||8||
lines.translation: In the noble congregation of the Sangat, one's state and way of life become noble as well, and one crosses over the terrifying world-ocean. ||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਗੁਰ ਤਰੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: ihu bhavajal jagat sabad gur tareeai ||
lines.translation: Through the Shabad, one crosses over this terrifying world-ocean.
The duality within is burnt away from within.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਬਾਣ ਲੇ ਜਮ ਕਉ ਮਾਰੈ ਗਗਨੰਤਰਿ ਧਣਖੁ ਚੜਾਇਆ ॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: pa(n)ch baan le jam kau maarai gagana(n)tar dhanakh chaRaaiaa ||9||
lines.translation: Taking up the five arrows of virtue, Death is killed, drawing the Bow of the Tenth Gate in the Mind's Sky. ||9||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤ ਨਰਿ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਕਿਉ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: saakat nar sabad surat kiu paaeeai ||
lines.translation: How can the faithless cynics attain enlightened awareness of the Shabad?
Without awareness of the Shabad, they come and go in reincarnation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਰਾਇਣੁ ਹਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: naanak guramukh mukat paraain har poorai bhaag milaaiaa ||10||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukh obtains the support of liberation; by perfect destiny, he meets the Lord. ||10||
The Fearless True Guru is our Savior and Protector.
Devotional worship is obtained through the Guru, the Lord of the world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧੁਨਿ ਅਨੰਦ ਅਨਾਹਦੁ ਵਾਜੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: dhun ana(n)d anaahad vaajai gur sabad nira(n)jan paaiaa ||11||
lines.translation: The blissful music of the unstruck sound current vibrates and resounds; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Immaculate Lord is obtained. ||11||
He alone is fearless, who has no destiny written on His head.
God Himself is unseen; He reveals Himself through His wondrous creative power.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਅਤੀਤੁ ਅਜੋਨੀ ਸੰਭਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸੋ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੨॥
lines.transliteration: aap ateet ajonee sa(n)bhau naanak guramat so paaiaa ||12||
lines.translation: He Himself is unattached, unborn and self-existent. O Nanak, through the Guru's Teachings, He is found. ||12||
The True Guru knows the state of one's inner being.
He alone is fearless, who realizes the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਅਨਤ ਨ ਮਨੁ ਡੋਲਾਇਆ ॥੧੩॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar dekh nira(n)tar boojhai anat na man dolaaiaa ||13||
lines.translation: He looks within his own inner being, and realizes the Lord within all; his mind does not waver at all. ||13||
He alone is fearless, within whose being the Lord abides.
Day and night, he is delighted with the Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥੧੪॥
lines.transliteration: naanak har jas sa(n)gat paaeeai har sahaje sahaj milaaiaa ||14||
lines.translation: O Nanak, in the Sangat, the Holy Congregation, the Lord's Praise is obtained, and one easily, intuitively meets the Lord. ||14||
One who knows God, within the self and beyond,
remains detached, and brings his wandering mind back to its home.

lines.gurmukhi: ਊਪਰਿ ਆਦਿ ਸਰਬ ਤਿਹੁ ਲੋਈ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੫॥੪॥੨੧॥
lines.transliteration: oopar aad sarab tihu loee sach naanak a(n)mrit ras paaiaa ||15||4||21||
lines.translation: The True Primal Lord is over all the three worlds; O Nanak, His Ambrosial Nectar is obtained. ||15||4||21||
Maaroo, First Mehl:
The Creator Lord is infinite; His creative power is wondrous.
Created beings have no power over Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਉਪਾਇ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਦੇ ਆਪੇ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਚਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jee upaai rijak de aape sir sir hukam chalaaiaa ||1||
lines.translation: He formed the living beings, and He Himself sustains them; the Hukam of His Command controls each and every one. ||1||
The all-pervading Lord orchestrates all through His Hukam.
Who is near, and who is far away?

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਪਤ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਹਰਿ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਤਾਕੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: gupat pragat har ghat ghat dekhahu varatai taak sabaaiaa ||2||
lines.translation: Behold the Lord, both hidden and manifest, in each and every heart; the unique Lord is permeating all. ||2||
One whom the Lord unites with Himself, merges in conscious awareness.
Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, meditate on the Lord's Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਨਦ ਰੂਪ ਅਨੂਪ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਭਰਮੁ ਜਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: aanad roop anoop agochar gur miliai bharam jaaiaa ||3||
lines.translation: God is the embodiment of bliss, incomparably beautiful and unfathomable; meeting with the Guru, doubt is dispelled. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਧਨ ਤੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: man tan dhan te naam piaaraa ||
lines.translation: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is more dear to me than my mind, body and wealth.
In the end, when I must depart, it shall be my only help and support.
